value: Fragments of the Frozen Throne become part of the next forging. The scattered splinters are gathered through Icecrown Citadel and carried back to Darion, who says their old power can be sealed into Shadow's Edge. The repeated shard tally belongs to the long work of the raid, not a second plot. What matters to the story is that the axe is being finished with fragments of the Lich King's own seat.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
